title: Pocket Scan
summary: Paper pages to one PDF: straightened, cleaned up, saved on your phone
description:
**Pocket Scan** turns paper into a PDF: letters, receipts, forms and notes, without ads, accounts or tracking.

**What it does**

- **Scan with the camera.** Take a photo of a page and the app finds its edges for you. Drag a corner if it's off.
- **Or start from photos** you already took, up to 20 at once.
- **Straight and clean.** Each page is straightened and the shadows are taken out. Pick Enhance, Grayscale, Black & white or the original photo for every page.
- **Put pages in order.** Turn a page, move it earlier or later, delete it or fix its corners again.
- **One PDF.** All pages become one file, fitted to the scan or on A4 or Letter. Save it on your phone or share it to the app you pick.
- **Your scans stay.** Documents are kept on your phone until you delete them, so you can add a page later.
- **Tips** for a clean scan: light, a dark background, the phone held flat, all four corners in view.
- **In English or Slovak**, following your phone's language.

**What it never does**

- No ads, no watermark, no page limit, no paid unlocks.
- No account and no sign-in.
- No internet access at all: your pages never leave the phone unless you save or share them.
- No analytics or tracking of any kind.
